schools.name: Troggs Surf School
schools.note: Running in Portrush since 1994, Troggs teaches from East Strand year-round by booking: group, one-to-one and private group lessons, kids' camps, sunset sessions and paddleboarding. Minimum age is 8, and lessons stay in waist-deep water with wetsuit, boots, gloves and hood supplied.

schools.name: Portrush Surf School
schools.base: Portrush Yacht Club, Harbour Road, Portrush
schools.note: Group, private, family and bodyboard lessons plus a kids' camp for ages 9-16, meeting at the yacht club with private changing rooms and hot showers. The school says its coaches know every break from West Strand to Whiterocks, so ask which beach your session will use.

hire.name: Troggs beach hire
hire.note: In summer you can hire wetsuits, bodyboards, beginner surfboards, SUPs and kayaks right at East Strand, for up to two hours at a time. It's cash only and closes if conditions are unsafe.

hire.name: Troggs Surf Shop hire
hire.note: Troggs' Main Street shop hires softboards, hardboards, bodyboards, 5/3mm wetsuits, SUPs and buoyancy aids, with ID and a card needed as a deposit. Kit is due back by 5:30pm.

shops.name: Troggs Surf Shop
shops.note: Troggs' main store, open daily, selling surfboards, softboards, bodyboards, SUPs, wetsuits for adults and kids, and accessories including ding and wetsuit repair kits. It has traded in Portrush since 1990 and also runs the hire desk.

shops.name: Troggs North Coast Boardriders
shops.note: A second Troggs store in Portrush with shorter opening days (Thursday to Sunday afternoons, per the Troggs site).

shops.name: Rip Curl store (Troggs)
shops.note: A Rip Curl store listed by Troggs Surf School, open daily, for wetsuits, clothing and accessories.

lessonsIntro: East Strand is home to Northern Ireland's longest-running surf school, and it's where most beginners on the North Coast take their first lesson. You can book group, private, family and kids' sessions with two Portrush schools.

text: East Strand is a long sandy beach running from the edge of Portrush towards Whiterocks, and the council describes it as popular for surfing all year. Troggs runs its lessons from the watersports centre on the strand, and both Portrush schools keep beginners in waist-deep water with a leash on. Lifeguards work alongside instructors, so you'll be told where to sit, paddle and stand up. You don't need any experience, but you should be comfortable in the water.

RNLI lifeguards cover East Strand daily from 10am to 6pm in July and August, with weekend patrols either side of the summer. Even on a sandy beach the sea can change quickly: in September lifeguards rescued a bodyboarder here who was pulled out by a flash rip in offshore wind. Troggs says autumn tends to bring better swell and quieter, smaller groups, while summer is busier but warmer. If the surf isn't suitable, both schools reschedule.

cards.label: Level
cards.title: Good for first-timers
cards.text: Lessons run in waist-deep water with qualified coaches and lifeguards. Troggs takes learners from age 8; Portrush Surf School from 9.

cards.label: Best time
cards.title: Summer for warmth, autumn for waves
cards.text: Lifeguards patrol daily in July and August. Troggs points to autumn for better swell and smaller lesson groups.

cards.label: Watch out for
cards.title: Flash rips in offshore wind
cards.text: Lifeguards have rescued bodyboarders caught in rips here. Outside patrol times, check weather and tides and read the beach signage.

hireIntro: You can hire kit right on East Strand in summer, or from Troggs' shop on Main Street in Portrush the rest of the year.

text: For a first go on East Strand, a big soft-top is the board to use: Troggs' lessons use 8ft Alder softboards and its shop only hires hardboards to competent surfers. The sea here is cold for much of the year, so even in summer you'll want a full suit, and from late autumn to spring you'll need boots, gloves and a hood. Bodyboards and SUPs can be hired on the beach in summer.

cards.label: Board
cards.title: 8ft softboard to start
cards.text: Schools use 8ft soft-tops for lessons. Move to a hardboard only once you can read swell, wind, rips and tides, as Troggs requires for hire.

cards.label: Wetsuit
cards.title: 5/3mm most of the year, 5/4mm plus extras in winter
cards.text: Sea temperature data for East Strand puts late-summer water at roughly 13-16°C (a 4/3mm or 5/3mm works) and late-winter water at about 7-9°C, when a 5/4mm or 6/5/4mm with boots, gloves and a hood is advised. Local schools issue 5/3mm winter suits as standard.

cards.label: Other craft
cards.title: Bodyboards, SUPs and kayaks
cards.text: All three can be hired on the strand in summer. Troggs and Portrush Surf School both run SUP sessions, and Portrush Surf School teaches bodyboarding.

shopsIntro: Portrush has the North Coast's main cluster of surf shops, all within the town a short walk from the strand.
shopsText: Troggs has been selling surf gear in Portrush since 1990 and its main store on Main Street stocks boards, wetsuits and accessories, and handles hire. There's a second Troggs store on Causeway Street and a Rip Curl store on Bath Street. In summer Troggs also runs a beach shop at East Strand. The council notes cafés and shops within walking distance of the promenade.

lessons.q: Where do surf lessons on East Strand start?
lessons.a: Troggs Surf School runs from the East Strand Watersports Centre on the beach. Portrush Surf School checks you in at Portrush Yacht Club on Harbour Road, then heads to the beach for the day.

lessons.q: How old do you need to be for a surf lesson in Portrush?
lessons.a: Troggs takes learners from age 8, with parental consent for under-18s. Portrush Surf School's group lessons start at 9, and its summer kids' camp is for ages 9 to 16.

lessons.q: Are lessons on East Strand cancelled if the surf is bad?
lessons.a: Yes. If conditions aren't safe or suitable, Troggs reschedules, refunds or gives a gift card, and Portrush Surf School may cancel or move sessions in high winds.

hire.q: Can I hire a board on East Strand itself?
hire.a: In summer, yes. Troggs runs beach hire at the East Strand watersports centre with surfboards, bodyboards, wetsuits, SUPs and kayaks. It's cash only and hire lasts up to two hours.

hire.q: Do I need a lesson before hiring a surfboard in Portrush?
hire.a: Troggs asks that you've had at least one beginner lesson before hiring a softboard, and hardboards are only for surfers who understand swell, wind, rips and tides. Staff will also tell you which beach suits the day.

shops.q: Where's the nearest surf shop to East Strand?
shops.a: Troggs' main store is at 88 Main Street in Portrush town centre, and in summer there's also a Troggs beach shop on East Strand.

No repair service confirmed (Troggs sells DIY repair kits only). No adaptive surfing confirmed at either Portrush school.
